svg.title: From your code to an online website
svg.desc: Your website starts as code on your computer. Deploying puts it on another computer that stays online. A browser can then request its pages across the Internet. The cloud drawing represents the Internet network, not the hosting computer.

svg.text: JUST THE IDEA · NO TECHNICAL WORDS
The page comes back to your screen
TOAD helps you put your website on that other computer.
